Traditional mechanical systems

and ADAS), industrial, and
healthcare are transforming into
smart, connected ecosystems,
with the sustained increase

serving as a primary driver of
global ESDM growth.
The Road Ahead for the Industry
The global electronics supply chain is undergoing a fundamental rewiring. OEMs
are increasingly seeking strategic partnerships that offer deep vertical integration,
moving away from transactional supplier relationships towards long-term,
capability-driven engagements. This evolution is defined by two major shifts:
The Rise of HMLV
Manufacturing

distinct transition towards high-
mix, low-to-medium volume
(HMLV) manufacturing. This
model is built around advanced,
high-precision sectors such as

demands of this model requires
agile production lines and rapid
prototyping capabilities, structurally
favouring integrated ESDM players
over traditional high-volume mass
producers.

Incentives

holidays for high-tech manufacturing,

and electric vehicle (EV) component
manufacturing.

testing as an integrated offering.

Definition of Senior Management as per SEBI (Listing
Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations,
2015:
“Senior Management” to include the officers and
personnel of the listed entity who are members of
its core management team, excluding the Board of
Directors, and all the members of the management
one level below the Chief Executive Officer or
Managing Director or Whole-Time Director or Manager
(including Chief Executive Officer and Manager, in
case they are not part of the Board of Directors). The
new definition also covers all the functional heads,
by whatever name called and the Company Secretary
